[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 40[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[b][size=large][color=#eeeeee]This week we have hit our 40th edition. We have come so far in just over 9 months. We would be officially born in this world if the HF News was a human baby at this point and we can't thank every one of you members who have supported us to this point. We are here to help the community grow, learn, engage, and develop. You are all so awesome, and we thank you all for following the team and supporting us with the work we put in each week. Thank you, yes you.[/color][/size][/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2331053]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6322070][color=#ffffff]Image Uploading and Embedding[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

A brand new feature has been released this week regarding adding images to your posts/threads. The feature allows users to add images to the site easily and to be encrypted. The site it's hosted on is owned by [mention=1] and they have mentioned this is all currently a beta, but more will come from this now that it's working as intended. The feature is thanks to a member of the site known as [mention=5052823] as they were creating a project for image encrypting and from this the feature was worked out with them both working together to bring the site the feature we mentioned.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321144][color=#ffffff]"Draw A Winner"[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=123]

With the recent change regarding giveaways, [mention=123] has created a thread for the hosts to let the winner be picked at random from one of the current staff members of the site. With this thread, we feel it's a great addition to the changes happening to help combat the scam giveaways we have seen popping up around the site and another great way to stop them happening moving forward. If you are hosting a giveaway and need someone to pick a winner, this thread is something you all should be using moving forward.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]The Risk of Sitting Too Long[/b][/color]  

Many young people spend hours sitting—whether working, gaming, or scrolling on their phones. Prolonged sitting can slow metabolism, weaken muscles, and increase the risk of obesity and heart-related issues. It can also lead to back and neck pain over time. Health experts recommend standing up, stretching, or walking for a few minutes every hour to keep the body active. Movement, even in small amounts, plays a key role in maintaining long-term health.

[hr]

[color=#00369B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]  

Don’t overthink every decision. Taking action, even if imperfect, is better than staying stuck. You can always adjust your path, but you can’t improve something you never started.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]  
“Action is the foundational key to all success.” — Pablo Picasso

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321724]😆 100,000 Bytes Contest 🙃 $250 Value - Upgraded Members Only (New Contest)[/url] By [mention=5418830] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

[mention=5418830] is at it again with another 100,000 bytes giveaway this month. The giveaway ends on the 1st of April 2026 this time around and is the same as the last giveaway. All you need to do is give the post a quick love, give [mention=5418830] max pop you are able to give, and reply to the thread. It is very simple for such a large number of bytes to have the chance to grab.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321287]$50 Crypto Contest || 1 Winner || Ends 31 March || LTC[/url] By [mention=516470] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

Litecoin is up for grabs with [mention=516470] newest giveaway. This giveaway has recently started and is being represented by the group "The Brotherhood" The giveaway is very easy to enter and all you need to do is make a post in the replies in the thread, give some rep, and have been a site member for at least six months. We wish everyone the best of luck with the giveaway.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6321316]200$ Crypto Giveaway - CRACK THE SEED - Part 3[/url] By [mention=7] [/color][/size][/b][/u]

A little bigger giveaway has turned up from the legend himself [mention=7] this week. The giveaway is a little different to most. The giveaway is to whoever can crack the seed. Now what does this mean? We hear you ask. Well, this is like a puzzle giveaway where you will get 12 mnemonic words needed to access the wallet. The one who can complete them all wins the $200 SOL. If you think you have the skills for this, go and check out the thread for more details about how to obtain the first hints.

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Amazon plans smartphone comeback more than a decade after Fire Phone flop[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Amazon is reportedly preparing a return to the smartphone market with a new device project that may lean heavily on Alexa and artificial intelligence to differentiate it from Apple and Samsung.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/technology/amazon-plans-smartphone-comeback-more-than-decade-after-fire-phone-flop-2026-03-20/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Samsung plans more than 73 billion dollars of investment to lead in AI chip sector[/color][/size][/b][/u]
Samsung Electronics said it plans to invest over 110 trillion won in 2026 to strengthen its semiconductor leadership, with a major focus on artificial intelligence chip development.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/business/samsung-electronics-plans-over-73-bln-investment-lead-ai-chip-sector-2026-03-19/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Elmos Semiconductor explores a possible sale as consolidation pressure grows[/color][/size][/b][/u]
German chipmaker Elmos Semiconductor is exploring a potential sale, highlighting continued interest in semiconductor assets as automotive and industrial chip demand evolves.
[b][url=https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-semiconductor-group-elmos-exploring-sale-sources-say-2026-03-19/]Source[/url][/b]

[u][b][size=large][color=#ffffff]Companies remain dangerously underprepared for AI driven cyber threats[/color][/size][/b][/u]
A new security report says only a small minority of organizations are ready to deal with AI powered threats, despite growing overconfidence and wider exposure to deepfake and identity attacks.
[b][url=https://www.techradar.com/pro/security/only-9-percent-of-global-firms-are-ready-to-handle-ai-driven-threats-and-many-are-dangerously-overconfident]Source[/url][/b]
